## Checklist

- [ ] The linked issue is labelled `accepted`. The `PR policy` check requires one, and labelling the issue does not re-run it — re-run the check afterwards ([ADR-0090](docs/adr/0090-accepted-issue-pull-request-gate.md)).
- [ ] The verify command for every area this touches — the table in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) § Before submitting — ran and is green.
- [ ] Tests cover the change: a new test for new code, an updated one for changed behaviour.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an `[Unreleased]` entry, or the change needs none.
- [ ] A structural decision is recorded as an ADR under [`docs/adr/`](docs/adr/), or none is needed.
